description: ECHO: Search EPA-regulated facilities by location, county, facility name, NAICS industry code, environmental program, or compliance status across CAA, CWA, RCRA, TRI, and SDWA. Returns facility name, EPA Registry ID, coordinates, county FIPS code, per-program registration flags, TRI facility IDs, five-year inspection and penalty totals, and TRI release totals. Registry IDs returned here feed epa_echo_get_facility; TRI facility IDs feed epa_tri_get_facility_releases. Supports proximity search via latitude + longitude + radius_miles, whose rows add distanceMiles from that point. At least one geographic filter (zip_code, state, city, county_fips, or a complete latitude+longitude+radius_miles triple) is required — unscoped searches time out. Page past limit with offset and nextOffset.

active_only.description: When true, return only facilities with an active permit

city.description: City name, case-insensitive; matches cities that begin with it ("TACOMA", or "SEAT" for SEATTLE and SEATAC). Pair with state.

county.description: County name, case-insensitive. A trailing County, Parish, Borough, City and Borough, Census Area, or Municipality is dropped ("King County" searches KING), then it matches recorded county names that begin with it, so KING in VA also matches KING GEORGE. Requires state, and matches in each state listed. Covers every registration ECHO places in the county, including ones with no program record that county_fips leaves out.

county_fips.description: 5-digit county FIPS code, state + county (e.g. "53033" for King County, WA); matches it exactly and scopes a search on its own. Leaves out registrations with no program record, which county includes.

facility_name.description: Facility name words, case-insensitive: every word must appear as a whole word, in any order, in a name ECHO records for the facility, so "BOEING" matches BOEING PLANT 2 and "OEING" matches nothing. A match can come from another name ECHO records for the facility, so a returned name can lack the words. No commas. Pair with a geographic filter.

has_violation.description: When true, return only facilities with at least one program in significant noncompliance (complianceStatus "Significant Violation")

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Pair with longitude and radius_miles for proximity search.

limit.description: Number of facilities to return in one call. Default 25; a larger value returns at most 2,500 and says so. Page past it with offset and nextOffset.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Pair with latitude and radius_miles for proximity search.

naics.description: NAICS industry code, 2–6 digits; fewer than six match every code that begins with them ("3364" for aerospace product and parts manufacturing). Pair with a geographic filter.

offset.description: Number of facilities to skip before this page (default 0). Pass the previous call's nextOffset to continue; a value past the end returns an empty page.

programs.description: Restrict results to facilities registered in one environmental program — ECHO filters on a single program per search, so pass one value. CAA=air, CWA=water, RCRA=hazardous waste, TRI=toxic releases, SDWA=drinking water.

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles around the given latitude/longitude (max 100). Requires latitude and longitude.

state.description: 2-letter state or territory codes (e.g. "WA", "PR"), case-insensitive, matching any of them. Required with county. ECHO also files facilities under codes outside the USPS set, such as DM for offshore Gulf of Mexico platforms; any 2-character code is searched as written.

zip_code.description: 5-digit ZIP codes to search within, matching any of them; a ZIP+4 such as "98108-1234" searches its first five digits

name: epa_echo_search_facilities

effectiveQuery.description: The search as sent upstream, in input names: values, match modes, and result-changing defaults, "; "-joined.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_geographic_filter`: No zip_code, state, city, county_fips, or latitude+longitude+radius_miles. `incomplete_proximity`: Only part of latitude, longitude, and radius_miles. `county_requires_state`: county without state. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

distanceMiles.description: Great-circle miles from the search point, to two decimals; absent without a search point or row coordinates.

programs.description: Flags for the programs the programs filter selects

sdwa.description: Has an SDWA water system record

tri.description: triFacilityIds is non-empty, whether or not it reported in the latest year

registryId.description: FRS Registry ID; pass it as registry_id to epa_echo_get_facility

totalPenaltiesInDollars.description: Formal-action penalties in dollars, last five years, all programs

triFacilityIds.description: 15-character IDs in ECHO's order, not reporting-year order; pass one as facility_id to epa_tri_get_facility_releases. Several mean successive operators.

triReleasesTransfersInLbs.description: TRI releases and transfers in pounds, ECHO's latest TRI year; for per-chemical detail pass a triFacilityIds entry, not the Registry ID, to epa_tri_get_facility_releases

limitNotice.description: Present when a smaller limit than requested applied; says why.

message.description: Recovery hint on an empty page; absent otherwise.

nextOffset.description: Next offset; absent on the last page.

notice.description: Present when more facilities follow: the continuing offset.

title: Search EPA Facilities
